_meta.coverage_metric: deterministic procedural necessity of the retained RCA rules, Agent A/B harness integrity, and held-out corpus separation
_meta.purpose: Keep three claims apart that a single green run would otherwise merge: that each retained rule is necessary on committed fixtures, that the harness which would measure a live Agent is itself sound, and that the corpus such a measurement would run against is actually held out.

runnable.hollow_mutations: removing a retained rule without a deciding score delta, treating a supporting rule as field-supported, counting dependency fraction by tokens rather than semantic claims, and letting an unbounded runtime receipt stand
covers: every retained rule has an ablation whose removal decides at least one case
the candidate profile outperforms no_skill without losing the full composition's outcome
dependency fraction is a semantic claim count, not a token count
the committed runtime receipt stays bounded
observation digests are reproducible across interpreters, so the expectation is not pinned to one machine
runnable.expected: the generated effectiveness report matches the committed expectation byte for byte on any interpreter; 13 retained rules each carry a deciding ablation and core_supported_fraction is 1.0

runnable.good_evidence: a matched cell set whose receipts bind agent provider, family, model, version and harness, scored by an evaluator that is not the evaluated Agent
runnable.hollow_mutations: an empty receipt set treated as an exercised experiment, a producer-owned evaluator, a tampered receipt, and a fixture agent's result read as prompt effectiveness
covers: an empty receipt set is not exercised rather than trivially passing
a producer-owned evaluator is an invalid experiment
a tampered receipt invalidates the experiment rather than lowering a score
the fixture agent validates the harness and never prompt effectiveness
runnable.expected: the harness admits a matched, independently evaluated cell set and refuses empty, producer-owned, tampered and fixture-as-evidence shapes; live model uplift remains NOT_EXERCISED

runnable.hollow_mutations: a tuning repository listed as held out, an unauthorized private repository, one repository listed three times, a corpus uniform in any declared dimension, a family naming an unlisted repository, required and forbidden evidence levels overlapping, a task digest equal to its ground truth, missing non-trigger or positive families, too few defect families, families sharing one ground truth, the evaluated Agent named as evaluator, and sealed material marked visible
covers: no listed repository was used to design the RCA-001..013 fixtures
the corpus varies across every dimension it declares, and one repository listed three times is not a set
non-trigger and positive families are required, so the corpus measures declining to escalate as well as escalating
a task digest equal to its ground truth would show the Agent the answer
the evaluated Agent cannot be named as its own evaluator, and sealed material marked visible is not sealed
a passing corpus is admissible to run, never evidence that anything ran
runnable.expected: the committed corpus of three public repositories covering all eleven families is admitted with zero network access; 12 planted separation, variation, family-coverage and sealing defects are refused; schema-level refusals stay distinct from semantic ones and absent input from both

established: deterministic necessity of the retained rules on committed fixtures
integrity of the harness and corpus contract that a live measurement would depend on
not_established: that any language model adopted the trimmed Skill
held-out uplift, cross-model generalization, or production correctness
that a held-out corpus exists yet -- the contract is checkable, the corpus is not written
